Protrusile_Teleost_Jaw.description: A highly specialized set of jaw bones (premaxilla and maxilla) that can be explosively shot forward, creating a sudden vacuum. This literally sucks prey into the suddenly expanded mouth cavity before they can react.

Revolving_Serrated_Dentition.description: A terrifying jawline featuring multiple conveyor-belt rows of razor-sharp, triangular teeth that are loosely embedded in the gums, rather than the jawbone. If a tooth is torn out while shearing flesh, a new one instantly rotates forward to replace it.
